subject: M11 Vanilla screenshot comparison harness and acceptance
description: Capture harness is BUILT and verified ready (not yet run). Vanilla 26.2 is launchable on this machine: Java 25 runtime at C:/Users/zht/AppData/Roaming/.minecraft/runtime/java-runtime-epsilon/bin/java.exe, 88/88 Windows libraries resolved, assets 5057/5057 present, and G:/ck-web26/client-26.2.jar sha1 matches the official manifest. Launch command: "<that java.exe>" @G:/ck-web26/launch.args — the argfile was generated by G:/ck-web26/make_launch.py from versions/26.2/26.2.json and points --gameDir at a CLEAN directory G:/ck-web26/shotdir so the Fabric instance (Sodium/Iris/Voxy/Xaero/REI, which all alter rendering) is never used. G:/ck-web26/shotdir/options.txt pins the comparison settings: ao true, graphicsMode fancy, mipmapLevels 4, renderDistance 12, fov 1.0, guiScale 4, entityShadows true, particles minimal, clouds on, maxFps 60, lang en_us. F2 writes to G:/ck-web26/shotdir/screenshots. Capture list: held block idle and mid-swing, held flat item, creative inventory with building blocks and the search tab, survival inventory, night with a single torch, sunrise, underwater, clouds seen from below, a village, a boat on water — plus one pass with the Complementary port enabled once M10 lands. BLOCKER TO RESPECT: C: is at 100% with only ~156 MB free and the machine was at 62% CPU with 6 GB of 24 GB RAM free while build agents ran, so do not launch until those agents finish, and keep every artifact on G:. Comparison protocol: our terrain generator is not vanilla, so compare per feature (AO gradient, hand scale and sway, light falloff, water tint and waves, cloud layer, UI layout) at matched time of day, never per-pixel terrain. Interim fallback references from the wiki: Torch_JE7.png, Torch_Orientations.png, Inventory.png, Survival_Inventory.png, Sky.png, Clouds_sunrise1.png, Cave_clouds.png, SmoothAnimSmal.gif, Light_falling_into_lush_cave.png, Coral_reef_at_night.png, Midnight_survival.png, Flooded_Pyramid.png, Village_going_into_Jungle.png — none of these show a first-person hand, so the real capture is required for M16/M10 acceptance.
